notes: Corrected on the same ground as 2.10: in דֶּגֶל מַחֲנֵה אֶפְרַיִם לְצִבְאֹתָם יָמָּה the definite construct phrase is the subject and יָמָּה the predicate, so rule 20 sends the construction's copula to the predicate rather than leaving it beside the subject where the ASV writes it.
The copula is placed on the directive he, which holds the English On and stands where rule 49's preposition stands; putting it on יָם's own unit instead is named in that unit's note.
